mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market contraction, indicated by a 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over one month, signals weakening demand and rising recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities due to deteriorating corporate revenue outlook, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a concurrent rise in unemployment (UNRATE), indicates a supply-side shock coupled with labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12mo MA and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% per annum, sustained over two consecutive months, signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during sustained FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in residential construction (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average, combined with a concurrent rise in real personal consumption (RSAFS), indicates a strengthening in private demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 12mo MA and RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the joint signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during the joint signal, or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters, as measured by the year-over-year change, indicates a deepening economic slowdown that triggers risk-off behavior in equity markets, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < 0 for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during two consecutive quarters of negative GDPC1 YoY growth, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
